title: Life Stories
welcome_lead: Personal narratives — childhoods, turning points, milestones — give Experiences its emotional weight.
meta_desc: IBDP French: life stories, biographical narration, milestones.
final_note: Telling a life in French is choosing which tenses carry the past.

walkthroughs.body_html: Quand j'etais petit, j'habitais... — use imparfait for ongoing past states. Add sensory detail: je me souviens de l'odeur du pain frais.
For events before another past event: quand je suis arrive, il etait deja parti. Use avoir/etre in imparfait + past participle.
Add reflection with avec le recul (in hindsight) or retrospectivement. These elevate your register for Paper 2.
